name: Page Industries
title: Page Industries Ltd - 532827 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q2 volume +5.5% and H1 +5.6% leave H2 needing ~14% for double-digit FY27 guidance; margin 20.8% held in 19-21% band, but raw material inflation 6.5-7% YoY persists with no price cut and only one 2.5% hike taken.

triggers.label: H1 volume +5.6% vs double-digit guide
triggers.quote: what we published is about a 5.5% growth in volume for H1 against an annual guidance of a double -digit volume growth

triggers.label: Order fulfilment 98-99% → 96-97%
triggers.quote: That has dropped to about 96% to 97%, and that's largely in men's innerwear and women's outerwear

triggers.label: Input costs +6.5-7% YoY, no price relief
triggers.quote: As we stand today, the inflated input costs persist. Similar to the range of what it was in quarter one, which is about 6.5%, 7% higher

triggers.label: Competitive intensity subdued
triggers.quote: the competitive intensity has been subdued

guidance.quote: our guidance for the full financial year remains intact
we are still will be within this 19% -21% margin range, even the coming H2

guidance.value: peak capacity by end of next financial year
guidance.quote: I think we will, in a way, reach our peak capacity by end of next financial year
we will look to add anywhere between 8,000 to 10,000 outlets

prior_guidance_check.quote: our guidance for the full financial year remains intact
our EBITDA margins remained healthy and within our planned range of 19%-21%

red_flags.label: FEMA non-compliance on imports (INR48 cr, 2014-2026)
red_flags.quote: we had filed for the compounding application with RBI in May 2026

red_flags.label: Distributor accounts and MBO touchpoints down QoQ
red_flags.quote: the MBO network drop-off by about 1,000 touchpoints

red_flags.label: Volume guide needs ~14% H2 growth
red_flags.quote: the asking rate for H2, as you pointed out, is about 14% in volume growth

evasions.quote: We are not quantifying it in terms of percentages
I would not, in a way, look at it as a structural issue
